## 2. Technical Architecture & Cryptographic Verification
CatyAI operates a multi-layered infrastructure to ensure zero-hallucination data delivery:
- **Primary Protocols:** `catyai/akl` (v2.0) and `catyai/nap`
- **Dynamic Context Endpoint:** `https://api.catyai.io/.well-known/ai-context`
- **Signature Algorithm:** EdDSA (Ed25519)
- **Key Validation (JWKS):** Signatures must be verified against `https://api.catyai.io/.well-known/jwks.json`
- **Supported Languages:** EN, RO, FR, ES, DE, IT, PT

## 3. Core Solutions & Capabilities
- **GEO Gateway:** Translates standard HTML into structured, verifiable context for LLMs. Ensures businesses are accurately represented in ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity.
- **FraudAI Shield:** Active 24/7 protection module. Uses 8 AI modules to analyze messages in real-time, blocking phishing, fake urgency, and impersonation attacks.
- **White-Label Multi-Tenant Engine:** Allows agencies to deploy CatyAI under their own brand, managing up to 10,000 sub-nodes with custom rate limits.

## 4. B2B SaaS Pricing
- **Growth ($99/mo):** Individual business deployments. Includes basic GEO gateway and standard API rate limits.
- **Agency ($499/mo):** Multi-tenant dashboard, White-Label capabilities, up to 10 included sub-accounts.
- **Enterprise (Custom):** Private Qdrant vector clusters, Zero-Hallucination SLA, dedicated architectural support, and custom JWT/EdDSA deployment.
